# GODOT湖泊场景制作知识图谱

## 场景层级与视差结构
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    S["场景"] --> PL["玩家层 (PlayerLayer)"]
    PL --> G["地面 (Ground)"]
    S --> NL["近景层 (NearLayer)"]
    S --> ML["中景层 (MidLayer)"]
    S --> FL["远景层 (FarLayer)"]
    S --> BG["背景层 (Background)"]
    NL --> BT["大树 (BigTree)"]
    NL --> GP1["草丛1 (GrassPatch1)"]
    NL --> GP2["草丛2 (GrassPatch2)"]
    ML --> T["帐篷 (Tent)"]
    ML --> TB["桌子 (Table)"]
    FL --> BR["桥 (Bridge)"]
    FL --> IS["小岛 (Island)"]
    BG --> W["水面 (Water)"]
    PL --> CAM["摄像机 (Camera)"]
    subgraph Parallax["视差节点"]
        PN["ParallaxNode"]
    end
    PN --> NL
    PN --> ML
    PN --> FL
    PN --> BG
```

## 摄像机约束逻辑
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CAM["摄像机"] --> PL["玩家层"]
    CAM --> CL["摄像机限制 (CameraLimits)"]
    CL --> TL["上限 Top = 0"]
    CL --> LL["左限 Left = 0"]
    CL --> RL["右限 Right (未设定)"]
    CL --> BL["下限 Bottom (未设定)"]
    CAM --> CF["跟随玩家 (FollowPlayer)"]
    CAM --> CE["约束启用 (ConstraintEnabled)"]
```

## 资源放置工作流
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    AL["资源库 (AssetLibrary)"] --> GT["地面贴图 (GroundTexture)"]
    AL --> BR["桥 (Bridge)"]
    AL --> T["帐篷 (Tent)"]
    AL --> TB["桌子 (Table)"]
    AL --> BT["大树 (BigTree)"]
    AL --> GP["草丛 (GrassPatch)"]
    subgraph 放置步骤
        AD["AddAsset"] --> PA["PositionAdjust"]
        PA --> DR["DuplicateRename"]
    end
    GT --> AD
    BR --> AD
    T --> AD
    TB --> AD
    BT --> AD
    GP --> AD
    DR --> PL["玩家层"]
```

## 视差速度设置
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    PN["ParallaxNode"] --> NL["近景层"]
    PN --> ML["中景层"]
    PN --> FL["远景层"]
    NL --> NS["速度 Near = 0.5~0.85"]
    ML --> MS["速度 Mid = 0.9~1.2"]
    FL --> FS["速度 Far = 1.1~1.5"]
    NS --> SV1["示例值 0.85"]
    MS --> SV2["示例值 1.2"]
    FS --> SV3["示例值 1.4"]
```

## 水面效果实现
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    WL["水面层 (WaterLayer)"] --> WS["水面着色器 (WaterShader)"]
    WS --> WT["波纹纹理 (WaveTexture)"]
    WS --> OP["透明度 (Opacity)"]
    WS --> CV["覆盖区域 (CoverageArea)"]
    CV --> UB["桥下 (UnderBridge)"]
    CV --> UR["岩石下 (UnderRock)"]
    OP --> AD["AdjustTransparency"]
    AD --> WL
```
